verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's dashboard aggregates revenue and MRR across countries (e.g., Rico can answer 'why did MRR drop in Germany') and charts support segmentation/filtering, implying some cross-currency consolidated reporting, but there is no explicit documentation of setting per-currency price points or a home-currency conversion/reporting feature for finance teams. missing for 10: explicit per-currency price-point configuration, currency conversion methodology, and dedicated finance/home-currency reporting documentation.
